flashcard_questions.q: University-trained doctors who diagnosed illness and prescribed treatments.
Which term means the bodily fluids — blood, yellow bile, black bile and phlegm — that doctors believed had to stay in balance for good health?
Which visual guide let a medieval physician diagnose an imbalance from the colour, smell and taste of a patient’s sample?

flashcard_questions.a: A chart showing the positions of stars and planets, consulted by medieval physicians to determine the best time to carry out treatments such as bloodletting.
The practice of deliberately removing blood from a patient, either by cutting a vein (venesection), applying leeches, or using heated cups (cupping).
